description: This file implements a class 'VoiceWakeTester' for testing voice wake word detection using speech recognition and audio input. It manages starting and stopping voice recognition, handling results, and debug logging for voice trigger detection, primarily for development and testing purposes within an iOS/macOS application.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTestState
classes.description: Enumeration representing different states of the voice wake test, including idle, requesting, listening, hearing some phrase, finalizing, detected, and failed.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: A class responsible for managing voice wake word detection using Apple's Speech framework and AVFoundation, including permission handling, starting/stopping recognition, and processing recognition results.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts voice recognition with specified triggers, microphone ID, and locale, and sets up callbacks for state updates.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends recognition gracefully with a timeout.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Handles recognition results, checking for match, processing final results, and updating state.

methods.name: scheduleSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check to detect silence to determine end of speech.

methods.name: logInputSelection
methods.description: Logs the preferred input device details.
